sourceTitle: How we’re putting one of quantum mechanics’ deepest features to the test at scale.
originalTitle: How we’re putting one of quantum mechanics’ deepest features to the test at scale.

blocks.text: Today, in new research published on the cover of Science, Google Quantum AI demonstrated that contextuality — a quantum property scientists believe powers certain quantum algorithms — survives at scale on our quantum processor.
blocks.zh: 今天,我们...发表在科学封面上的新研究中,Google Quantum AI 演示了背景质量——一位量子属性科学家相信某些量子算法的力量——在我们量子处理器上在规模上生存.
blocks.en: Today, in new research published on the cover of Science, Google Quantum AI demonstrated that contextuality — a quantum property scientists believe powers certain quantum algorithms — survives at scale on our quantum processor.

blocks.text: What gives quantum computers their unique power? While entanglement usually gets the spotlight, theory suggests that a deeper quantum property called contextuality may power certain quantum algorithms. In simple terms, contextuality means a system’s properties aren’t fixed in advance; what you measure depends on which other compatible measurements you make alongside it.
blocks.zh: 什么让量子计算机拥有它们独特的力量?缠绕一般会引人注意理论认为,更深层的量子属性称为上下文性,可能为某些量子算法提供动力.简而言之,上下文意味着系统属性不是事先固定的;你测量的量取决于你同时进行哪些其他兼容的测量.
blocks.en: What gives quantum computers their unique power? While entanglement usually gets the spotlight, theory suggests that a deeper quantum property called contextuality may power certain quantum algorithms. In simple terms, contextuality means a system’s properties aren’t fixed in advance; what you measure depends on which other compatible measurements you make alongside it.

blocks.text: Until recently, this effect had mostly been shown in small systems of just a few particles. Our paper in Science now demonstrates this at scale on our quantum processor. Using it, our qubits won a well-known coordination game 98.3% of the time, beating the 88.9% classical limit, and outperformed constrained classical strategies in tasks spanning up to 105 qubits.
blocks.zh: 直至最近,这种效应主要表现在只有少数粒子的小系统中。我们的"科学"论文现在在量子处理器上 大规模地证明了这一点。用它来我们的qubits赢得了98.3%的知名协调赛,打破88.9%的古典极限,在长达105个方格的任务中,它的表现超过了受制约的古典战略。
blocks.en: Until recently, this effect had mostly been shown in small systems of just a few particles. Our paper in Science now demonstrates this at scale on our quantum processor. Using it, our qubits won a well-known coordination game 98.3% of the time, beating the 88.9% classical limit, and outperformed constrained classical strategies in tasks spanning up to 105 qubits.

blocks.text: These tests also serve as a sensitive new method to catch subtle hardware errors, helping pave the way for real-world applications like chemistry and materials science. Read the full Google Research blog post to learn more.
blocks.zh: 这些测试也是一种敏感的新方法 来捕捉微妙的硬件错误,帮助为化学和材料科学等现实世界的应用铺平道路。阅读Google Research的完整博客文章以学习更多.
blocks.en: These tests also serve as a sensitive new method to catch subtle hardware errors, helping pave the way for real-world applications like chemistry and materials science. Read the full Google Research blog post to learn more.
